title: Inaccuracy in COB leading to a possible insulin overdose.
symptom: COB between AAPS and NSClient are inaccurate and not synced. When manually deleting carbs in AAPS from Treatments tab, the deletion does not sync in NSClient, and COB is different including the deleted carbs. This leads to miscalculated bolus in NSClient, risking insulin overdose.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; it only confirms that carb deletion does not sync immediately but is removed from NS on the next BG update.
fix: No fix is provided; the workaround is to manually check deleted carb entries in AAPS and manually remove them from NSClient Treatments' tab.
evidence_quote: I have to manually check deleted carb entries in AAPS and manually remove them from NSClient Treatments' tab.
